answer: Meadow-mesa citation bond: each agent locks 70 credits, claims a meadow plot and cites three independent mesa datum surveys, key-signed. Auditors trace each chain to its nadir, its oldest mesa datum; a chain whose nadir is the agent's own filing, a copy, or a phantom datum burns it. First 30, k-th 30+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,027,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. Rented rings fail: one key, one chain, one plot. Honest agents pay 30 once.
